_note: Every ID, stage and rule for the Implementations refresh. Changed only by commit. Why: T-tools/02-workflows/implementations-weekly-refresh.md

window._note: Required by the shared run helpers.

target._managed_note: Same fields the page already has; Base44 drops unknown field names, so nothing new is ever added.

hubspot._stage_note: Today's 12-stage pipeline (2026-11-12). Alex proposed a new board on 2026-11-03 (Closed-Won/Awaiting Kick-Off, Kick-Off, Implementation In Progress, Launched-Hypercare, Won-Active, FTL); when HubSpot changes, update this block by commit. A stage ID not listed here stops the run.

rules._note: Activity dates use the date a record entered its current stage (hs_v2_date_entered_current_stage), not last-modified: the Monday.com mirror touches most records every morning. Aging = open, owned or not, in its current stage for aging_days_in_stage+ days. Recently completed = entered Live or Hyper-care within recently_completed_days.
rules._decision: Will, 2026-11-12: the worklist, aging, recently-completed and capacity sections come from the HubSpot implementation object (agreed system of record, 2026-11-06), replacing the Existing Launches sheet (a Jira export, unedited since October). Sparse HubSpot fields show as gaps and are reported, not filled in. Jira board totals and the PDE follow-up list have no HubSpot source and are left empty.

validation._note: Stop if HubSpot returns fewer records than min_records, or the open count moves more than max_open_change_pct vs the live record.
